## Problem & who has it

What hurts today, and for whom (a user or a role)?

## Proposed solution

What should happen instead? Any UI or API impact?

## Specification (required)

We run spec-driven development: **an issue and a SPEC exist before code does** — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [`.ai/specs/README.md`](../../.ai/specs/README.md).

**Does a spec exist for this feature?**

- [ ] Yes — path: `.ai/specs/YYYY-MM-DD-{slug}.md`
- [ ] No — I will create one (allocate `SPEC-NNNN` from the registry, with the mandatory `## Acceptance criteria` block) before implementation starts

## Acceptance criteria

If the spec exists, list the AC ids this issue delivers:

`Implements: AC-01, AC-02`

## Additional context

Links, mockups, or technical notes.
